item.description: Blindness As part of UN International Holocaust Remembrance Day, Booth Library held “The Auschwitz experience in the art of prisoners” on Jan. 27. item.title: Panthers of the Week: Bryce Riggs, Meechie White
item.description: The first Panther of the Week is going to Bryce Riggs from the baseball team. The junior right-hander from Cicero, Indiana, pitched a complete seven innings in Eastern’s 2-0 win over Florida A&M on Saturday. Riggs allowed two baserunners, one hit and one walk, and struck out six batters. Riggs was named the OVC pitcher...

item.title: Sankofa Awards to replace annual Miss Black EIU pageant

item.title: Mattoon insurance agency celebrates 80th anniversary
item.description: The Gardner-Whitworth Insurance Agency in Mattoon is celebrating its 80th anniversary in 2026 after years of providing insurance to the area. When coming back from World War II, Kenneth and Ruth Gardner created Gardner Real Estate and Insurance.
